authority.source_authority: The Logos repositories, exact Git revisions, machine-readable evidence manifest, deterministic validators, and named human owner retain authority; this mesh only coordinates the bounded public portfolio release.

non_overlap_statement: Only portfolio-release-writer may edit the stewardship worktree. Every reviewer is read-only, the mechanical actuator may perform only the separately authorized unchanged-head GitHub release sequence after all gates pass, no role may delegate, and the paused residue-repair lane remains untouched.

roles.why_needed: One accountable writer prevents overlap while assembling the frozen doctrine specification and public evidence packet.
roles.mission: Author only the claimed public portfolio, navigation, manifest, schema, validator, test, dependency-map, validation-contract, and specification-release bookkeeping paths.
inputs: authorized family claim and overlap resolution
roles.authority: Sole writer inside the authorized stewardship lane; cannot launch runtime work, ingest sources, implement doctrine, alter authority gates, force Git operations, or mutate other worktrees.
acceptance_conditions: Public claims resolve to inspectable evidence
Frozen candidate is handed to non-author reviewers

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass on one exact candidate state

roles.why_needed: A public trust-layer portfolio must not rely on the author's interpretation of its own evidence.
roles.mission: Re-derive counts, paths, maturity labels, digests, links, and non-claims from raw repository evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only independent checker; cannot edit, approve theology, waive a finding, or authorize release.
acceptance_conditions: Every material claim is supported or rejected
stop_conditions: A material claim cannot be reproduced

readiness_conditions: Raw permitted evidence and frozen candidate are available

roles.why_needed: Public release can expose workstation data or overstate theological and operational authority even when structural tests pass.
roles.mission: Red-team privacy, sensitive patterns, provenance, authority leakage, anti-hype boundaries, and specification-versus-runtime labeling.
roles.authority: Read-only red-team; cannot edit, grant publication authority, approve doctrine, or weaken repository gates.
acceptance_conditions: No private locator or credential signal

readiness_conditions: The exact public candidate is frozen

roles.why_needed: The packet must be understandable to a recruiter and independently interrogable by another AI without sacrificing precision.
roles.mission: Review narrative hierarchy, Mermaid readability, navigation, evidence drill-down, transferable engineering value, and honest maturity language.
roles.authority: Read-only experience review; cannot rewrite the candidate or promote roadmap and specification claims to delivered capability.
acceptance_conditions: Every diagram has a prose alternative

readiness_conditions: The exact public candidate is frozen

roles.why_needed: The authorized remote sequence should be performed mechanically against one unchanged, fully checked head.
roles.mission: After all local and independent gates pass, stage only approved paths, create scoped commits, push without force, open the governed PR, wait for required CI, recheck the unchanged head, and merge normally.
roles.authority: Mechanical release effects only within the user's exact authorization; no force, admin bypass, unrelated staging, repair authorship, branch deletion, or cleanup.
acceptance_conditions: Normal merge contains the reviewed commits

readiness_conditions: All dependencies pass at the unchanged candidate head

proof_obligations.description: Prove every committed path belongs to the stewardship claim and no paused or held worktree was modified.
Prove every material portfolio claim has an inspectable source, maturity class, limitation, and reproducible validation rule.
Prove doctrine-mesh-v2 remains validated design only and is not described as runtime, completed doctrine, ingested research, or theological authority.
Prove privacy, provenance, links, tests, independent review, unchanged-head, CI, and normal-merge gates all passed without bypass.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Scripture interpretation, source authority, doctrine, tradition policy, and qualified theological approval remain outside this public engineering release.
Agent runtime selection, provider qualification, budgets, source ingestion, live research, substantive implementation, and production deployment remain separately human-gated and unstarted.
